Messages.Author: Luis P. Duarte
Messages.Body:
Hi!

What happens if 2 minions are in combat and one inflicts
2 aggravated damage and the other steals 2 blood?
Does the second go to torpor or the blood she steals
prevents the damage inflicted by the first?

When i play a political action card, can i immediatly draw another
card or only in the final of the turn?

Can i play political cards during a blood hunt, to get more votes?

And can i tap "Ventrue Headquarters" to gain 3 votes during
a blood hunt?

Does a minion with "Pentex Subversion" untaps as normal?
And if another minion sucessfully burns it, can the first minion
play an action immediatly or she has to wait for the next turn?

Thanx a lot!

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Luis P. Duarte wrote:
> What happens if 2 minions are in combat and one inflicts
> 2 aggravated damage and the other steals 2 blood?
> Does the second go to torpor or the blood she steals
> prevents the damage inflicted by the first?

? Torpor.
Stolen blood does not prevent damage in any situation.
Stolen blood can be used to heal, just like any blood.

> When i play a political action card, can i immediatly draw another
> card or only in the final of the turn?

If it is the PA being played by the acting vampire to call the
vote, it is replaced immediately as usual.
During a referendum (the "during a political action" part of
a political action), no cards are replaced - so if you burn
a PA for a vote at that time, it is not replaced.

When you replace it is a matter of which rules you're using.
In a DCI tournament, you don't replace it until the end of the
current turn. Otherwise, you replace it at the end of the
action.

> Can i play political cards during a blood hunt, to get more votes?

Yes.

> And can i tap "Ventrue Headquarters" to gain 3 votes during
> a blood hunt?

Yes, since it doesn't specify "only during a political action."

> Does a minion with "Pentex Subversion" untaps as normal?

Yes.

> And if another minion sucessfully burns it, can the first minion
> play an action immediatly or she has to wait for the next turn?

Immediately.
